ngaap.guidance: 2022 guidance (reiterated, 28-Apr-2022): Revenue $17.3B - $17.7B; organic revenue growth up 1.0% - 3.0%; GAAP net income margin 12.00% - 12.25%; segment operating margin 16.00% - 16.25%; GAAP EPS $10.75 - $11.05; non-GAAP EPS $13.35 - $13.65; operating cash flow $2.4B - $2.5B ($2,405 - $2,505M); adjusted free cash flow $2.15B - $2.25B (assumes $600M - $700M R&D capitalization cash tax impact); free cash flow $2,075 - $2,175M; capex ~$330M; cash used for merger integration ~$75M. By segment: IMS revenue $7.1B - $7.3B (up 2.0% - 4.0%), margin 13.50% - 13.75% (prior year 13.5%); SAS $6.0B - $6.1B (flat - up 2.0%), margin 12.50% - 12.75% (prior year 12.8%); CS $4.4B - $4.5B (up 2.0% - 4.0%), margin 24.25% - 24.50% (prior year 24.3%). Other: net FAS/CAS pension adjustment ~$540M (FAS pension service cost ~(45), CAS pension cost ~(145), FAS/CAS operating adjustment ~100, non-service FAS pension income 440); net interest expense ~$265M; integration expenses ~$35M; non-GAAP effective tax rate ~15%; average diluted shares ~194M. Reconciliation (midpoint revenue $17.5B): segment operating income $2,800 - $2,850M; unallocated corporate department expense ~(15); merger integration ~(35); amortization of acquisition-related intangibles ~(605); FAS/CAS operating adjustment ~100; non-operating income ~440; net interest ~(265); income taxes ~(320); net income $2,100 - $2,150M. EPS bridge: integration ~0.18, amortization ~3.12, NCI portion ~(0.02), total pre-tax ~3.28, taxes ~(0.68), total after-tax ~2.60.
ngaap.notes: Segment operating income / margin (non-GAAP in total): sum of segment operating income, excluding unallocated items (unallocated corporate department expense, L3Harris Merger-related integration expenses, amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, divestiture / impairment items, other items) and the FAS/CAS operating adjustment; from fiscal 2022 segments are charged CAS pension cost and the former 'pension adjustment' (which included non-service FAS pension income) is replaced by the FAS/CAS operating adjustment, with non-service FAS pension income in non-operating income (comparatives recast). Non-GAAP EPS: EPS from continuing operations excluding amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, L3Harris Merger-related integration expenses, divestiture-related gains/losses and expenses, impairments and other items, net of tax and the NCI portion; FAS/CAS operating adjustment and non-service FAS pension income are NOT excluded (remain in non-GAAP EPS). Adjusted free cash flow: net cash provided by operating activities less net additions of property, plant and equipment, plus cash used for L3Harris Merger integration costs (and net cash paid for income taxes associated with business divestitures, where applicable). Non-GAAP effective tax rate: tax rate on non-GAAP pre-tax income. The FCF bridge in the release is for the quarter (three months); cf in this file is year to date. Q1-22 adjustments: $1M unallocated corporate, $20M merger integration, $152M amortization, $1M other items; taxes on adjustments $(39)M. Adjusted EBITDA (quarter) 857; net debt / adjusted EBITDA (LTM) 1.8x. No adjusted EBIT measure published this quarter.
